judgments.reason: The span 'a large choroidal melanoma confirmed by histopathology and metastatic workup' supports the primary tumor history but does not mention or support the 'intrinsic high-density areas' component of the completed label.

The span 'Orbital CT showed a well-defined isodense intraconal lesion' describes the lesion as isodense, which does not clinically support the modifier 'with intrinsic high-density areas'; it actually contrasts with it.

The span 'with intrinsic high-density areas' occurs literally in the vignette as part of the CT description and directly supports the modifier describing intrinsic high-density areas within the orbital lesion.
